gradient.usage: IDENTITY MOMENTS ONLY: logo, header rule, section dividers, dark AI band accent, hero numbers in video stat cards. NEVER on buttons, body text, form controls, or card backgrounds.

identityVersion: Locked brand (MEMORY.md locked creative standards; reaffirmed Oct 19 + Oct 21, 2026 founder handoffs)

logo.description: Single master: angled 'F' + 'Faqada' wordmark in the cyan→blue→violet identity gradient.
rules: Use the official file bytes; only scale, never retype, recolor, redraw, or rotate.
The wordmark reads 'Faqada' — never 'Faqada Marketing' (that is the legal entity name only).
All-white variant is for dark surfaces; no standalone white-variant file exists locally yet (known gap).
Never place content over the logo; never use it as a profile picture (OpenAI badge rule is separate; this is the house rule for the master logo in designed assets — use as supplied).

retired.apricot: No apricot exists in the locked palette. A Sept 2026 'Cobalt & Apricot' application palette survives only in a superseded repo document; do not use.
retired.clearBlue: The V2 'Clear Blue' Twitter theme (Open Sans, #087BFC primary, flat gradient) is an app theme state documented as pending token restoration to this locked brand (Oct 19 plan, RD-01).
retired.dotgothic16: Retired from all brand/video materials Oct 22, 2026 (it was Ajay/@thevibefounder's face, never Faqada's).
retired.fullSpectrum2026: The repo's brand/2026 'Full-Spectrum 2.0' system (Inter, Midnight/Deep Navy, tagline 'Train smarter. Build faster. Scale with AI.') is NOT the locked brand.

surfaces.mark.faqada.com: Founder personal one-pager (photo-led; Faqada logo small in header/footer; no personal logo exists — do not design one)
